E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Ihievbe [ihi],
also known as Ihewe, Isewe, Ihiebe and Sebe. But Ihievbe [ihi] is rather a section of the Emai-Iuleha-Ora [ema] language
(**hh:hvw:Elugbe:Edoid**:16,
**hh:hv:JungraithmayrGanslmayr:Westafrika**:34,
**hh:hvw:Lewis:North-Edoid**:95-96). See also: Emai-Iuleha-Ora [ema].
